title: Apprehension of deserters.
bodyText: Any civil officer having authority to apprehend alleged offenders under the laws of the United States or this State or of a state, territory, commonwealth, or possession, or the District of Columbia, may summarily apprehend an alleged deserter from the state military forces and deliver the alleged deserter into the custody of the state military forces. If an alleged offender is apprehended outside the State, the alleged offender's return to the State shall be in accordance with normal extradition procedures or reciprocal agreement.
bodyHtml: [§124B-12]  Apprehension of deserters.  Any civil officer having authority to apprehend alleged offenders under the laws of the United States or this State or of a state, territory, commonwealth, or possession, or the District of Columbia, may summarily apprehend an alleged deserter from the state military forces and deliver the alleged deserter into the custody of the state military forces.  If an alleged offender is apprehended outside the State, the alleged offender's return to the State shall be in accordance with normal extradition procedures or reciprocal agreement. [L 2022, c 286, pt of §2]
